claims.quote: If you do not have the fictional supporting copy, obtain it from the fictional Records Desk after registration. Use this route instead of preparing an existing copy. Form preparation can proceed independently.
If you already have the fictional supporting copy, prepare it after registration. Use this route instead of obtaining a copy at the Records Desk. Form preparation can proceed independently.
After registration, prepare the fictional application form. It can be prepared independently of the applicable supporting-copy route. Both items are required for submission.

Register at the fictional Registration Desk before preparing the form or supporting copy. Each of registration, preparation and submission has a fictional LKR 0 fee. After registration, the form and the applicable copy route may proceed independently; both are required before submission.

Submit to the fictional Submission Desk only after preparing the form and completing the applicable copy route. Include both the fictional completed form and supporting copy. Completing just one preparation is insufficient.
